description:
Create a new project named 'RespSurveillance' in Epi Info 7. Design a form with two pages:

Page 1 'Patient Information':
- CaseID (Text, Required)
- FirstName (Text)
- LastName (Text)
- DOB (Date)
- Age (Number, Read Only)
- Sex (Legal Values: Male, Female, Unknown)
- County (Text)

Page 2 'Clinical Information':
- OnsetDate (Date)
- Fever (Yes/No)
- Cough (Yes/No)
- SoreThroat (Yes/No)
- Dyspnea (Yes/No)
- Diagnosis (Legal Values: Influenza, COVID-19, RSV, Other, Unknown)
- Hospitalized (Yes/No)
- Outcome (Legal Values: Recovered, Deceased, Under Treatment, Unknown)

Implement Check Code for the form:
- In the DOB field's After event, auto-calculate Age using: ASSIGN Age = YEARS(DOB)

After creating the form, open the Enter module and enter these 3 records:
1. RS-0001, Maria Gonzalez, DOB: 03/15/1978, Sex: Female, County: Fulton, Onset: 01/10/2025, Diagnosis: Influenza, Symptoms: Fever, Cough (others No), Not Hospitalized, Recovered.
2. RS-0002, James Thompson, DOB: 11/22/1955, Sex: Male, County: DeKalb, Onset: 01/12/2025, Diagnosis: COVID-19, Symptoms: Fever, Cough, SoreThroat, Dyspnea, Hospitalized, Under Treatment.
3. RS-0003, Aisha Patel, DOB: 06/08/2001, Sex: Female, County: Cobb, Onset: 01/14/2025, Diagnosis: RSV, Symptoms: Cough, SoreThroat (others No), Not Hospitalized, Recovered.

Note: The Age field should populate automatically.
